title: messages.c validate_dao_options comment still cites repudiated 'flags ignored per 8.7.1' rule
description: Found by kimi-k3 correctness review of b7z9.3.2 (comment-only, no behavioral defect). lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:346-349 — validate_dao_options comment says 'reserved flags and bits beyond the Prefix Length are ignored' citing spec 8.7.1. The function is intentionally structure-only, but after b7z9.3.2 any nonzero-flags DAO is rejected downstream by extract_updates (rpl_dao_process.c) per 8.6 R-05-035; the comment should say flags are deferred to semantic ingest (8.6 R-05-035), not 'ignored per 8.7.1', or a future reader will re-introduce the acceptance bug the C test suite just had corrected. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.3.2.
close_reason: Comment corrected: validate_dao_options RPL_TARGET arm (messages.c:370-378) no longer cites the repudiated 'flags ignored per 8.7.1' acceptance rule; it now states the layer is structure-only and defers flag semantics to semantic ingest (8.6 R-05-035, rpl_dao_process.c). Comment-only, no behavioral change. Verified: rpl_dao_sequence host suite builds clean, 2/2 ctest pass. 3x codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, edge-cases PASS; security pass filed one P3 residual as project-LICHEN-worker6-x0bb (same stale phrasing in dao_targets_authorized doc comment, rpl_dao_process.c:445-446, pre-existing). Pass-1 observation (structural layer permits prefix_len==0, ingest rejects /0) assessed truthful/non-defect, not filed.
